fails_if: the curation compiler routes an unguarded `unresolved_source_event_endpoint` acknowledgement to the global matcher instead of refusing it with `acknowledge_global_guards_missing` at its entry, so a global acknowledgement could match without its evidence and diagnostic digests
note: Event and lineage acknowledgements are matched outside a register's scope, so they must carry both digests; the build refuses one without them before any event is resolved.
